notes: the opening «ما كان فيه عن أبي بكر الحضرمي، و كليب الأسدي» names the book's sources, not the chain; the chain's last level is the pair written after «عن» («؛ و كليب الأسدي»)
«أبي» (the author's father) is named only by the kinship word: relation (rule 7)
the gloss «رضي الله عنه» is left out
